adelheid.title: Poison Taster
adelheid.text: Adelheid insists on tasting all of your food for poison before you touch a fork. Every single meal, silver spoon first, pale blue eyes narrowed behind the scar through her brow while she inspects tavern stew, crusted bread, and one deeply suspicious pear like an assassin hid beneath the peel. Only over the final bite—when you catch her lingering long after your plate sits clean—does she admit stiffly that dinner hour has become her favorite watch.
ngpp: Mid-bite she pauses staring down at the spiced stew, muttering faintly that she somehow already knew you dislike fennel.
"Forgive an old soldier's odd instinct, Sam," she says stiffly, pushing the sweet pear straight toward your preferred side before tasting it.
Adelheid skips the rigid inspection altogether tonight, sharing the plate openly beside your elbow. "I cannot recall why I trust your table above any fortress kitchen, Sam—only that I do."

choices.label: Ask her to stay for the whole meal
choices.res: She sits across from you in her armor, straight-backed, and eats a whole meal as a guest instead of a guard for the first time. She is very bad at it.

choices.label: Tell her she's allowed to finish the pear
choices.res: "Strictly for safety," you say, handing her the pear. {N} accepts it as a sacred duty, and eats it in tiny, reverent bites.

image.comp: in armor tasting food from his plate with great seriousness, napkin tucked in
image.setting: inn dining room at dinner time

adelheid.title: Rain Barrel
adelheid.text: You cut through the training yard and find Adelheid washing off after practice at the rain barrel, cold water streaming down her scarred shoulders, her short platinum hair plastered flat. She snaps to attention. With the hand holding the towel. Which is, therefore, no longer holding the towel, quite as well as it should.

1.title: Out of Armor
1.text: You step into the washroom after evening watch and find Adelheid already wrapped loosely in a thick linen bath towel, short platinum hair wet at the collar, carefully oiling a fresh bruise along her shoulder. When she sees it's you, she doesn't snap upright or bolt—she only swallows once, steel-blue eyes softening beneath bright scarlet ears. "Ah... I thought you were already asleep, Sam."

choices.label: Take the salve jar and rub her scarred shoulders gently
choices.res: Adelheid closes her eyes tightly as your warm knuckles press through knotted sword-muscle, leaning back into your palms until she turns her face up for a slow, trembling kiss.
choices.fallbackRes: She sits stiff as a lance for three seconds before letting out a slow breath and leaning her damp head gently back against your wrist.

choices.label: Leave a warm cup of cider on the stool and step back
choices.res: "Thank you, Sam." Her quiet smile follows you out into the hall.

3.title: Unarmored
3.text: Steam fills the washroom from corner to corner, and for once not a scrap of steel sits anywhere near Adelheid. Sitting bare in the cedar tub with water lapping over proud collarbones and faded battle scars, she meets your gaze without flinching and holds out one damp hand. "Bolt the door, Sam. Duty finished an hour ago."

choices.label: Slide into the hot tub and hold her close
choices.res: All knightly stiffness melts instantly in hot water as Adelheid climbs across your thighs, biting down softly on her lip while you guide your cock inside her warmth and move slowly beneath the rising steam.

choices.label: Kneel beside the tub and take care of her slowly
choices.res: Her hands grip the oak rim until her knuckles blanch as she yields completely to your hands and mouth in the quiet steam.

choices.label: Turn around immediately
choices.res: "Thank you, Sir Sam," she says, in a very small voice, after your footsteps retreat. She holds the towel with both hands for the rest of the day.

choices.label: Salute back
choices.res: She laughs: a real, startled laugh, the first you've ever heard from her, rough and surprised, like a door that hasn't been opened in years.

choices.label: Stammer helplessly
choices.res: You both stand there stammering at each other until a goose interrupts, honking, and the knight loses her last thread of dignity.

image.comp: snapping to attention beside a rain barrel, soaking wet, covering herself with one arm and saluting with the other
image.setting: training yard behind an inn, afternoon

adelheid.title: Knight and Her Lord
adelheid.text: You find Adelheid's secret stash of romance novels in her saddlebag, cracked spines, pressed flowers, a ribbon marking every chapter. Every one is about a knight and her lord. She threatens you with her sword, steel flashing, face scarlet to the roots of her hair. Then asks, very quietly, if you've read the third one.

choices.label: Show her how volume three actually ends
choices.res: She lowers the blade three inches, drops the dog-eared novel onto the floor, and lets you pull her down beside the barracks lamp—scarlet from jaw to collar as fiction turns real.

choices.label: Ask which part of the third one is her favorite
choices.res: She tells you, with the sword still half-drawn and her eyes fixed on a point past your shoulder. It is the chapter in the rain. You take detailed notes, as is tradition.

choices.label: Hand the books back and promise silence
choices.res: You swear silence on your honor, which causes her to blush deeper. {N} sheathes the sword with great ceremony, and asks if you want to borrow volume two.

image.comp: pointing a sword at him while clutching a stack of romance novels to her chest, scarlet

adelheid.title: The Report
adelheid.text: The Order demands Adelheid report on "the sinful nature" of your business. She's been staring at a blank page for three hours, a candle burned to a stub beside her, the quill chewed ragged. Her oath and her honesty are pulling in opposite directions, and the sound of her sword-hilt tapping the desk fills the room.
ngpp: Even before lifting the quill, she pauses frowning—as if she already defended this quiet ledger before an inquisitor in some half-forgotten dream.
"Strangely, I know how every line of this defense ends before writing a word, Sam," she mutters softly, gripping the parchment tight.
Adelheid signs her name cleanly down the page without hesitation. "No tribunal erases what my heart knows of this house, Sam. Let them read the truth."

choices.label: "Tell them the truth."
choices.res: She writes three pages: fair wages, rest days, no one here against her will. She reads them twice and seals them with pride, the wax pressed hard.

choices.label: "Could you... leave some things out?"
choices.res: Her face goes hard. "I will not lie, Sam Takahashi. Not even for you." It's a long, cold week, and she guards your door like a stranger.

choices.label: Go to the Order with her
choices.res: You answer their questions yourself, politely, for four hours. Adelheid stands beside you the entire time, shoulders squared, not once looking away.

image.comp: sitting at a desk staring at a blank page, quill frozen, troubled expression

adelheid.title: Swordplay
adelheid.text: Adelheid decides a house owner cannot rely solely on locks and good manners, so she drags you out into the frost-crisp yard at dawn and thrusts a weighted ashwood practice sword into your hands. Your wrists howl by the fifth parry and an outraged rooster heckles from the coop roof, yet her platinum hair catches first sun as she adjusts your grip patiently: "Feet wider, Sam. Guard high. Again."

2.text: Adelheid drags you into the frost-crisp yard at dawn with two ashwood practice blades, standing noticeably closer than any sergeant should while correcting your elbow height and resting warm ungloved fingers lightly along your forearm. "Feet wider, Sam. Guard high," she murmurs—though her eyes drop briefly to your mouth whenever you step inside her reach.

image.comp: demonstrating sword guard posture in a misty morning courtyard, correcting the man's grip on a wooden practice blade
image.setting: dawn inn courtyard with wooden fence and training post

choices.label: Practice until you drop
choices.res: You drop. Twice. She tries looking stern, fails miserably, and lets her warm hand linger on your shoulder long past helping you up.

choices.label: Let her win on purpose
choices.res: She knows. She hates that. Her scar-split brow lowers dangerously. "Again, and properly this time."

choices.label: Disarm her and collect a reward back inside
choices.res: On the seventh exchange you catch her blade cleanly, step inside her reach, and walk a flushed, smiling knight straight back through the warm side door.

adelheid.title: The Amended Oath
adelheid.text: Adelheid kneels in the empty chapel hall to renew her oath, the candlelight turning her short hair to silver, then stays kneeling. "My oath was to guard you. I would like to amend it." Her voice is steady but her hand, when she takes yours, trembles. "To stand beside you—as yours, Sam." She rises, and doesn't let go.
ngpp: Her voice trembles slightly over the final vow—not from doubt, only the sudden vertigo of feeling she has knelt on these stones for you before.
"Forgive me," Adelheid whispers, holding your hand fast in the candlelight. "Why does pledging beside you feel like coming home to a vow already sworn?"
"Time and memory both bow before what steel remembers, Sam," Adelheid whispers steadily as she rises straight into your arms. "Every cycle, my oath belongs to you."
adelheid.goLead: Adelheid sets her sword belt reverently beside the chapel candles and steps straight into your arms, kissing you with shaken, resolute warmth as the latch clicks shut.

choices.label: Say yes
Not yet
choices.res: {N} bows her head, stiff with discipline. "I can wait. Don't make it too long." She resumes her post by your door, and stands one pace closer.
